templates.why_chosen: Star, high-confidence layered exemplar with an explicit three-row colour legend inside the frame tying 14 components to three roles, feeding from operator and developer inputs through a planning tier into a jointly labelled hardware-plus-runtime tier.
templates.what_to_learn: When more than two colours carry role meaning, put a compact legend inside a free corner rather than relying on labels alone, and let one hardware box be jointly annotated by two different functional tiers, a long-term planner's output above and a short-term runtime's control below, to show both act on the same resource.
